description: One row per expected visit of every person whose slot has been revealed: held visits with their reconciliation result, missed, withdrawn and pending visits. The integrity dashboard (#35) reads only this table and discrepancies. Producer #33; consumers #35, #34. Unique key: visit_id. CSV encoding and masking rules: analysis/docs/architecture.md and docs/interfaces/analysis.md.

actual_minutes.description: Run-sheet first start to last end, in minutes.

comfort_deviations_n.description: Deviation records of category comfort (comfort and welfare reports).

comfort_flag.description: Run sheet records a comfort adjustment or stop.

data_kind.description: Watermark: SYNTHETIC or REAL, equal to the data root's.

days_since_anchor.description: Calendar days from the anchor visit.

discrepancies_n.description: Discrepancies of checks C1-C7 plus DEVIATION_UNKNOWN.

fault_audio_underrun_n.description: Opportunities with at least one fault of type audio_underrun (vocab.FAULT_TYPES).

fault_failed_reset_n.description: Opportunities with at least one fault of type failed_reset (vocab.FAULT_TYPES).

fault_hash_mismatch_n.description: Opportunities with at least one fault of type hash_mismatch (vocab.FAULT_TYPES).

fault_missing_playback_n.description: Opportunities with at least one fault of type missing_playback (vocab.FAULT_TYPES).

fault_missing_response_log_n.description: Opportunities with at least one fault of type missing_response_log (vocab.FAULT_TYPES).

fault_n.description: Opportunities with any technical fault (lost opportunities included).

fault_other_n.description: Opportunities with at least one fault of type other (vocab.FAULT_TYPES).

fault_presentation_freeze_n.description: Opportunities with at least one fault of type presentation_freeze (vocab.FAULT_TYPES).

opportunities_n.description: Accounted scheduled opportunities of the visit (trials rows that are not retries, including lost opportunities).

pair_gap_hours.description: Study B V1-V3: hours between the two dyad members' session starts, on both members' rows (no role is shown).

pair_gap_ok.description: Study B V1-V3: windows.yoked_gap_ok for the pair.

person_id.description: Person slot (A-C07-L03, B-C12-M1). Coded participant IDs and the slot binding stay in the reveal log; no names or contact data anywhere.

station_id.description: Coded station ID from the exit manifest.

suspension_events.description: Suspension events raised by this visit.

unit_id.description: Study A matched batch or Study B dyad slot (A-C07, B-C12).

unresolved_n.description: Discrepancies without a valid deviation link.

visit.description: Visit (A D0, D7; B V1, V2, V3, W1, W4).

visit_date.description: Calendar date of the visit's first run-sheet start_time, in the UTC offset recorded.

visit_seq.description: 1-based order of the visit within its study.

window_hi_days.description: Last allowed day after the anchor.

window_lo_days.description: First allowed day after the anchor.

title: Per-visit status row (reconciled/visit-status.csv)
